content: MongoDB time series collections (5.0+, GA and improved through 8.0) are the recommended type for timestamped measurement data: automatic bucketing + columnar compression (50-90% storage reduction vs regular collections), much faster range queries. Capped collections are simpler ring-buffers for recent-only data but are mutually exclusive with time-series collections and lack compression/range-query optimization. Current backend runs MongoDB 8.0.26, fully supports time-series collections including downsampling.
